hero_intro: Big Pappy's back! Everything smoked in house. Big platters made for passing. Good times served family style.
story_paragraph_one: Saltlick is Hamilton’s place for true Southern-style BBQ—personally smoked in house to mouth-watering perfection and served with the kind of hospitality that makes a table feel like home.
story_paragraph_two: Original owner Shane McCartney is continuing the smokehouse tradition forward with family-style platters. Choose your meats, pass the sides and settle in. This is dinner without the fuss—and with plenty of napkins.
family_text: Our dining concept is simple: friends and family choose the meats and sides they want to share, then dig in together. No tiny plates. No stiff rules. Just a table full of food worth talking about.
catering_text: From a Saltlick menu favourite to a completely custom spread, we cater events of every size. Tell us what you’re planning—we’ll bring the good stuff.
hours:

menu_note: Dinner menu. Availability may change with the smoker and the season. Ask your server about tonight’s features, dietary needs and add-ons.
visit_intro: Southern barbecue on James Street North. Come for the smoke, stay for the platter and bring people who don’t mind sharing.
catering_page_intro: Weddings, corporate events, schools, banquets and backyard gatherings—from 50 to 1,000 guests.
catering_page_text: Our management team has more than 20 years of catering experience. With a mobile catering trailer, full-service options and food prepared for pickup or drop-off, we can build an event around the way you want to gather.
catering_minimum: On-site catering is customized to each event and starts at $3,000. For smaller budgets, ask about prepared pickup, drop-off and ready-to-finish barbecue options.
